title: [R3-016 browser core] Bind daemon authority to live affordances
description: SPIDR production child of task-c444b68f0ceb427c86f025f5469c4857 after fresh reachability found two additional behavior-asserting consumers that the original ten-path row could not own within the hard cap. Consume the daemon producer's seven-key planningAuthorityByRun wire material, bind it to exact parsed affordance identities, and retire the browser's stale graph/plan authority tuple. A measured journeyAuthority probe proves dependencyHash, qualityHash and policyHash are not returned by this producer; those existing internally consistent placeholders are explicitly not re-derived or falsely claimed fixed here. Preserve SurfaceFrame and DispatchInput exported shapes with a module-owned WeakMap keyed by exact parsed offers, preventing both a broad type fan-out and caller-supplied authority. Exact owned paths (10): apps/control-room/src/live/live-planning-authorities.ts (new); apps/control-room/src/live/live-planning-authorities.js (new one-line bridge); apps/control-room/src/live/live-board-feed.ts; apps/control-room/src/live/live-board.tsx; apps/control-room/src/live/live-board.test.tsx (adopt parent WIP); apps/control-room/src/live/live-dispatch.ts; apps/control-room/src/live/live-dispatch-payloads.ts; apps/control-room/src/live/live-board-dispatch.test.tsx; apps/control-room/src/live/live-board.a11y.test.tsx; apps/control-room/src/live/live-effort-path.test.tsx. Parent c444 retains the two real-daemon integration files and must dependOn this row. Exact 436-character completion gate: `& {$p='pnpm.exe';function x{&$p @args;if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}};x --filter @moe/control-room exec vitest run src/live/live-board.test.tsx src/live/live-board-dispatch.test.tsx src/live/live-board.a11y.test.tsx src/live/live-effort-path.test.tsx;x --filter @moe/control-room typecheck;x exec node -e "import('./apps/control-room/src/live/live-dispatch.ts').then(m=>{if(!m.payloadFor)throw 0;console.log('NODE_BRIDGE_OK')})"}`.
definitionOfDone: After both dependencies are DONE/merged, read their delivered completion/review records and inspect delivered bytes: the daemon surface has exact seven-key planningAuthorityByRun entries and the Control Room selector still joins kind+target+version. Verify apps/control-room/package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml declare/link @moe/contracts, then create/typecheck/delete in one PowerShell command a temporary Control Room probe importing the used JSON types/limits from bare @moe/contracts; record the full probe source.

Create <=250-line live-planning-authorities.ts and exact LF one-line bridge `export * from "./live-planning-authorities.ts";`. Descriptor-only parsing admits plain/null-prototype maps with <=256 entries and exact seven-key records, 512-byte ids, canonical bounded base64 and lowercase 64-hex hashes; nested authority is recursively snapshotted/frozen under shared max JSON bytes/depth and <=4096 nodes. Accessors, symbols, cycles, sparse/extra-key arrays, nonfinite numbers, or mapKey/runId/goalRef mismatch refuse without evaluation. Valid material is sidecar-bound only to exact parsed offers; SurfaceFrame and DispatchInput shapes stay unchanged.

live-board-feed leaves a wholly absent map optional but maps any present malformed/hostile value to exact `LIVE_SURFACE_UNREADABLE` without invoking getters. live-board requires exact offered run goal binding plus sidecar material before rendering plan.propose or approval.decide. live-dispatch refuses before budget reader/builder/transport with `PLANNING_OFFER_BINDING_ABSENT @ CONTROL_ROOM_LIVE_DISPATCH` for missing goal binding or `PLANNING_AUTHORITY_BINDING_ABSENT @ CONTROL_ROOM_LIVE_DISPATCH` for absent/misaligned material; goal.close remains target-only.

Remove GRAPH_CONTENT_BYTES, SUBMISSION_HASH, sealedAuthorityFor and planningChainFor plus every producer-owned static graph/plan operand from live-dispatch-payloads.ts. Keep payloadFor's exact signature/type and the DEV_PAYLOADS bidirectional roster; authority-less plan.propose/approval.decide return null. Initial propose carries authority/graph bytes/submissionHash; finalize replaces graphContentHash/graphRevisionRef/planHash; approval replaces actor, graphRevisionRef, activation.graphHash, exactRevisionHash, node scope and criteria identity from the same safely snapshotted authority. Do not invent replacements for non-producer dependencyHash/qualityHash/policy fields. payloads and new module are <=250 lines; all edited production files stay <400.

Red-first tests pin nonzero two-sibling A-first/B-dispatched selection, exact B-only graph/plan operands, hostile/accessor unreadability, distinct missing-goal and missing-authority code/layer fixtures with otherwise-accepting downstream seams and zero calls, and bidirectional planning-kind roster equality. Update live-board.a11y/live-effort-path approval surfaces with valid goal/material wire facts, never weaker expectations. Restored first-entry, retired graph/plan-hash and missing-material-fallback mutants make the named production-surface assertions red; untracked-file restores use separate out-of-tree SHA-256 proof.

Run exact foreground/unpiped `& {$p='pnpm.exe';function x{&$p @args;if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}};x --filter @moe/control-room exec vitest run src/live/live-board.test.tsx src/live/live-board-dispatch.test.tsx src/live/live-board.a11y.test.tsx src/live/live-effort-path.test.tsx;x --filter @moe/control-room typecheck;x exec node -e "import('./apps/control-room/src/live/live-dispatch.ts').then(m=>{if(!m.payloadFor)throw 0;console.log('NODE_BRIDGE_OK')})"}`; require focused Test Files 4 passed with nonzero Tests, package typecheck success and literal NODE_BRIDGE_OK. Then run full @moe/control-room tests and root typecheck/test/foundation/store lanes standalone as merge-base-versus-HEAD path-attributed baselines, with no new failure intersecting the ten owned paths and all foreign red disclosed verbatim.
taskRails: Own exactly the ten named paths; only live-planning-authorities.ts/.js are new. Do not edit daemon, integration acceptance tests, exported SurfaceFrame/DispatchInput shapes, manifests, lockfile, agent-wrapper, board-chain E2E, or foreign WIP.

Daemon material is authority for graph/plan identity. The browser may validate bounded transport shape/bindings and assemble bodies, but must not mint, hash, canonicalize, rotate, repair, default, choose a first entry, or accept caller-supplied authority.

The producer does not carry dependencyHash, qualityHash or policyHash. Preserve their existing consistent behavior without claiming remediation; if the DONE producer or a human ruling requires replacing them, block on a real producer rather than deriving or relabeling an unrelated digest.

Adopt live-board.test.tsx from parent 016 without restore/normalization. The two newly measured approval consumers are mandatory because the render fence changes their fixtures. Parent c444 is the real-daemon integration consumer and must dependOn this row before completion.

RED-FIRST PRODUCTION-SURFACE TESTS. In live-board.test.tsx extend the adopted two-sibling wire fixture with A inserted first and exact distinct A/B planningAuthorityByRun entries; add top-level and nested accessor/symbol/cycle/oversize/extra-key hostility through frameOfSurface, asserting exact LIVE_SURFACE_UNREADABLE and getter count 0, while a wholly absent or valid empty map remains CONNECTED and exposes no new SurfaceFrame key. In live-board-dispatch.test.tsx drive the exact offer object returned by frameOfSurface: (A) dispatch B with both siblings valid and assert every initial/finalize/approval graph/plan, author, node and criterion operand is B with no A/default literal; (B) keep B material sidecar-valid but pass no B goal binding, expecting PLANNING_OFFER_BINDING_ABSENT @ CONTROL_ROOM_LIVE_DISPATCH; (C) keep a valid B offer+goal binding but omit its material, expecting PLANNING_AUTHORITY_BINDING_ABSENT @ CONTROL_ROOM_LIVE_DISPATCH. For B/C use budget-reader, generated-builder and transport recorders that would accept, assert all three counters are zero, and assert BUILD_REFUSED so no later fence can answer first. Keep bidirectional set equality between an independently enumerated served planning-kind seam and DEV_PAYLOADS, with a nonzero denominator. Update live-board.a11y.test.tsx and live-effort-path.test.tsx wire fixtures to carry valid goal/material for every approval control they intentionally render/click; preserve their accessibility, cardinality and effort assertions rather than admitting missing authority. Run the four focused files and record the exact new production-surface assertions red with nonzero collected tests before implementation.

IMPLEMENT THE HOSTILE-SAFE AUTHORITY SIDECAR AND FEED COMPOSITION. Create live-planning-authorities.ts with explicit exported PlanningAuthorityMaterial plus four narrow operations: bindPlanningAuthoritySurface(response, goalRefs, offers), planningAuthorityRequired(kind), planningMaterialForAffordance(offer), and planningPayloadFor(...). In this step implement only transport admission/sidecar behavior: descriptor-read the top-level planningAuthorityByRun property; absence is valid with no bindings, while a present non-data/non-enumerable value is invalid. Admit only a plain/null-prototype map with <=256 own enumerable data entries/no symbols; each exact seven-key entry contains authority, goalRef, graphContentBytesBase64, graphContentHash, graphRevisionRef, runId, submissionHash; key/run/goal bindings agree with the already-decoded own-data planningGoalRefs. Bound identifiers are nonempty <=512 UTF-8 bytes, hashes are lowercase 64-hex, base64 is canonical and within shared string/body limits. Recursively clone authority through descriptors only, allowing JSON primitives, dense arrays and plain/null-prototype objects under MAX_JSON_DEPTH, MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES, MAX_JSON_STRING_UTF8_BYTES and 4096 nodes; reject accessors, symbols, cycles, sparse/extra array keys and nonfinite numbers, then deep-freeze. Bind each exact parsed plan.propose/approval.decide offer object to its matching immutable material in a private WeakMap; never bind goal.close, choose a first entry or accept an external map later. Add the exact LF one-line .js bridge. In live-board-feed.ts call the binder after goal refs and offers are safely decoded but before returning the frame; false returns the existing unreadable frame. Do not add a SurfaceFrame field or alter its returned string-key roster. Make the feed/parser tests green and keep new module <=250 and feed <400.

MINIMUM GRAPH/PLAN ASSEMBLY AND REAL UI/DISPATCH WIRING. Finish planningPayloadFor in live-planning-authorities.ts over the safely cloned material and the non-authority bases from live-dispatch-payloads.ts. Require own-data authority.acceptanceContract and planRevision bindings: matching authorRef, graphBinding hash/ref, planHash/submissionHash, affectedNodeIds, affectedCriterionIds and criteriaDigest; a missing/misaligned nested field returns null, never repairs. Version 0 plan.propose builds the established create/ready/claim/propose chain but carries the exact daemon authority, graphContentBytesBase64 and submissionHash; the finalize arm replaces graphContentHash, graphRevisionRef and planHash only, retaining the measured non-producer dependencyHash/qualityHash; approval replaces actor, graphRevisionRef, activation.graphHash, record.exactRevisionHash, approvedNodeScope and criteriaRef from that same material while retaining unrelated policy/quality fields and the later daemon budget commitment. In live-dispatch-payloads.ts delete GRAPH_CONTENT_BYTES, SUBMISSION_HASH, sealedAuthorityFor, planningChainFor and their stale graph/plan derivatives; keep DEV_PAYLOADS' independently tested served roster and the exact four-argument payloadFor signature, but make plan.propose/approval.decide return null without material and leave goal.close/nonplanning behavior intact. In live-board.tsx compute the exact offered object before eligibility, extend boardMayDispatch only with an optional exact-affordance argument (its measured callers are owned), require goal+sidecar material for plan/approval, and pass the same object into dispatch. In live-dispatch.ts use the shared authority-required predicate; require goal binding first, then exact sidecar run/goal material, translate missing/malformed assembly to PLANNING_AUTHORITY_BINDING_ABSENT @ CONTROL_ROOM_LIVE_DISPATCH, and place this guard before budget read, generated builder and transport. Preserve retry/pending/effort/report behavior and goal.close target-only semantics. Make all four focused files green; keep new module and payloads <=250 and every production file <400. Add only boundary comments explaining offer identity/why no derivation; no docs file is needed for this internal authenticated field, and the epic-final row owns the docs sweep.

PENULTIMATE ADVERSARIAL REVIEW AND RESTORED MUTATION DRILLS. Apply the adversarial-self-review checklist to repeated/concurrent renders, WeakMap identity lifetime, duplicated offers, missing/empty/huge maps, prototype/accessor traps, cyclic/deep authority, canonical base64, late budget reads, exact refusal ordering, source-compatible hint callers and plain-Node .js resolution. Back up the new/untracked TS/JS files to a worker-suffixed out-of-tree $env:TEMP directory and record SHA-256; also snapshot the pre-drill bytes of any already-dirty tracked path. Independently drill: (1) choose the first map entry instead of the offered run—both A/B facts and downstream seams remain valid, while the exact B-only body assertion must red; (2) replace one graphContentHash/graphRevisionRef/planHash use with the retired literal—choose fixture values that differ and require the pretransport exact-body assertion to red, so no daemon fence can mask it; (3) re-enable a missing-material fallback—keep offer+goal valid and downstream recorders accepting, requiring the exact authority code/layer and zero-call assertion to red; (4) replace one descriptor read with ordinary property access—use an accessor returning otherwise-valid material and require getter-count/LIVE_SURFACE_UNREADABLE to red. A green mutant is a finding, not evidence. Restore each mutation in a separate command; in later separate calls prove new/untracked SHA-256 equality and tracked bytes/diffs equal their pre-drill state. Run git diff --check over the exact ten paths and confirm no eleventh path or generated artifact is attributed.
